notes: This is the shared repo-wide event name library.
Not every event in this file is used by every task.
Per-session event_code_library.json files contain the minimal subset of event names, codes, event types, and descriptions actually used in that run.
Indexed AFC-style sequential events are defined through templates so option_{n}_dot and option_{n}_on do not need to be duplicated as static entries.
Code 109 (grey_inter_trial_interval) remains reserved for historical logs; active_foraging now records the choice-clear flip as reward_interval or timeout_interval.

gray_pre_sequence.description: Gray pre-sequence screen before the first stimulus appears.

stimulus_on.description: A stimulus became visible on the main display.

gray_inter_stimulus.description: Gray inter-stimulus screen after a stimulus was removed.

gray_final_fixation.description: Final gray fixation screen after the image sequence completed.

trial_cue.description: Trial-start fixation or cue screen before the first option presentation in the trial.

stimulus_dot.description: Pre-stimulus dot cue indicating the next stimulus location.

choice_start.description: The response window opened and a choice could first be made.

gray_inter_trial_interval.description: The display transitioned to the gray inter-trial interval.

onset_cue_on.description: The self-initiation onset cue became visible.

grey_inter_trial_interval.description: The display transitioned to the gray post-choice or inter-trial interval.

options_dot.description: Dot cues for all options became visible simultaneously.

options_on.description: Stimuli for all options became visible simultaneously.

video_clip_start.description: A video clip became visible on the main display.

video_clip_end.description: The display transitioned away from the video clip.

delay_start.description: The delay period began after cue offset and before choices appeared.

feature_cue_on.description: The trial's feature cue became visible.

match_cue_on.description: The match-to-cue target stimulus became visible.

inter_stimulus_interval.description: The unchanged dot-only interval between sequential stimuli began.

cue_touch.description: A touch or click was registered on the self-initiation cue.

training_cue_release.description: Contact with the training cue ended by release or movement outside the cue.

fixation_accepted.description: Gaze met the required continuous fixation duration within an option window.

saccade_timeout.description: The fixation wait timed out; the trial ended directly in the inter-trial interval.

training_trial_start.description: A training trial began on contact with the cue.

training_trial_end.description: A training trial ended on release or at its duration limit.

option_touch.description: A touch or click was registered on a selectable option.

match_cue_touch.description: A fresh touch or click was registered on the displayed match-to-cue target stimulus.

initiation_cue_release.description: The required initiation-cue hold failed before choice. Timestamp is the first missing-touch detection, before the release grace period; effective tolerance is recorded in block settings.

video_sync_signal_on.description: Frame-locked video sync GPIO signal onset.

video_sync_signal_off.description: Frame-locked video sync GPIO signal offset.

block_end.description: Task block ended and log finalization began.

reward_interval.description: The fixed-duration reward interval began at the post-choice gray-screen flip, including zero-pulse outcomes.

timeout_interval.description: A timeout interval began at the post-choice gray-screen flip, replacing the reward interval.

inter_trial_interval.description: The inter-trial interval began after the reward or timeout interval; the gray screen remains unchanged.

sync_bar_flip.description: All five synchronization rectangles inverted on the main display.

sync_signal_on.description: Synchronization GPIO changed high on the display flip callback.

sync_signal_off.description: Synchronization GPIO changed low on the display flip callback.

sync_start_end.description: Start packet final bit hold completed; presentation may begin.

sync_end_begin.description: Task presentation ended and end marker first bit displayed.

sync_end_end.description: End/date packet final bit hold completed.

afc_option_dot.description_template: Dot cue for option {option_index} became visible.

afc_option_off.description_template: Stimulus for option {option_index} was hidden on the main display, including the final clear to gray.
